reviewType: independent read-only static review and original/current byte comparison; no test rerun, build, install or workflow dispatch

findings.topic: Exact local URL and path boundary
findings.detail: LocalGameUrl accepts only the literal HTTPS origin and unchanged safe relative path grammar. Encoded/dot-segment/backslash paths, fragments, alternate authority/port/userinfo/scheme are rejected. Query is bounded at 4096, ASCII/percent syntax checked, control/DEL/backslash escapes rejected. Query is never decoded or concatenated into the asset name; getAssets.open receives only exact indexed assetPath. Unindexed/controller files remain denied. Query content can contain slash-like text without changing the selected local file.

Both navigation overloads and onPageFinished now recognize only tv.html with the accepted optional query. PageFinished still only hides the existing loading status and requests focus while active; it does not recreate the bridge, room, TCP port, DOM storage or clocks. HostBridge remains installed once on that WebView and retrieves the same room state. Native WebView reload/JS-interface availability and lifecycle behavior are not proven by this static review.

findings.topic: Target SDK selection and actual package enforcement
findings.detail: Low-level builder defaults to target29/min26 and permits only explicit integer29/35 keyword opt-in. Registered joystick caller selects35 only for backroad-rally,29 for all others. No game.json metadata/permissions/runtime input fields changed. Signing validation now checks min26/selected target against actual aapt badging both before and after signing, in addition to original certificate/source/payload checks; unsigned receipt must agree.

findings.topic: New Java production file included in source and package closure
findings.detail: android-build.sources recursively includes android/src/main and android-*.py; prepare copies the full native main tree; builder compiles all *.java. LocalGameUrl is covered by committed source checks, host DEX cache-key source bytes and compilation, with no hidden dependency path.

Read exact recorded 105 production Java URL checks,19 packaging tests, actionlint and aapt2/javac/d8/zipalign tiny unsigned fixtures. Both actual min26/compile35; targets29/35 differ only in AndroidManifest.xml, with identical DEX/assets. These do not demonstrate real WebView callbacks, installation, Play Protect acceptance, target35 insets or gameplay.

Two MainActivityTest additions and adjusted prior query assertions are present but no current workflow invokes Gradle/Robolectric/MainActivityTest/testDebugUnitTest. The catalog Android workflow runs only the standalone actual Java URL policy plus existing Python/web/build checks. The Robolectric fixture itself is configured sdk28/target29; even a later successful execution would not validate Android15 target35 edge-to-edge/insets. This is a documented limitation, not a claim that callback tests passed.

Independently streamed current dist file SHA256 values, unchanged shared controller bytes, deterministic metadata/index hashes and compared the complete map to the preserved original signed-build receipt. All338 entries matched. game.json matched the original source Git blob. No giant staged copy or APK rebuild was made.

remainingAcceptance: One real signed Backroad native runtime trial must exercise ordinary query-based menu/course navigation, query-bearing resources, controller input/focus/resume/storage and loading completion.
Target35 requires actual installation and screenshot/inset checks; neither Play Protect acceptance nor production bug resolution is claimed before those results.
Old original APK reuse must continue using original frozen production source references; these changed shared production bytes cannot masquerade as old package source.
